verdict.rationale: The SavvyCal REST API exposes version-prefixed endpoints (/v1/events, /v1/links/{link_id}), so the API is versioned in its URL paths. Nothing in the evidence describes a versioning strategy, changelog, or deprecation/sunset policy, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, a documented versioning/compatibility policy beyond the /v1 path prefix, a changelog or sunset timelines, a machine-readable spec, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: List events GET /v1/events ... Cancel event POST /v1/events/{event_id}/cancel ... Create event POST /v1/links/{link_id}/events
